versions.changelog:
- Bumped version number from 1.0.6 to 1.0.7 in SKILL.md.
- No functional or documentation changes made besides the version update.

- Updated installation instructions in SKILL.md to recommend pip as the primary method.
- Reorganized install steps for clarity and platform specificity.
- Removed "skill-card.md" file from the repository.
- Minor wording and formatting adjustments to improve guidance and readability.

- Added pip installation instructions for aitun in the documentation.
- Updated metadata to include installation via pip in addition to uv.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Added Windows (PowerShell) installation instructions for aitun.
- No other content changes.

- Docs: Updated installation instructions to remove `pip show aitun` as a verification method; now recommends only `which aitun`
- No functional or code changes in this release—documentation update only

- Updated installation instructions to use the official aitun install script (`curl -fsSL https://aitun.cc/install.sh | bash`) instead of `pip install aitun`.
- Clarified the CLI reference to reflect the new recommended installation method.
- No changes to core functionality.

Version 1.0.1

- Added a version key to SKILL.md for improved version tracking.
- Updated CLI reference in SKILL.md: clarified usage of `-p` and `--tcp-ports` flags, including TCP-only mode details.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
Initial release - receive external webhooks via aitun tunnel
